approval_class: DESTRUCTIVE - removes existing account-level negative criteria
verification_required_before_apply: Confirm in the Google Ads UI under Tools > Shared library > Account-level negative keywords that this list is the active account-level list. The API reports member_count 0 while shared_criterion returns 59 rows, so the UI is the authoritative check.
readback_procedure: 1. SELECT shared_criterion.resource_name, shared_criterion.keyword.text FROM shared_criterion WHERE shared_set.id = 11252984411. ASSERT exactly 46 rows remain.
2. ASSERT every approved removal resource_name is absent.
3. ASSERT every retained member is present with the SAME text and match type - diff the full list against all_59_members_with_verdicts.
4. ASSERT the other 16 shared sets are unchanged: same ids, names, member counts.
5. ASSERT campaign_shared_set associations are unchanged account-wide.
6. ASSERT the five live campaigns still return ENABLED / SERVING with unchanged budgets.
7. ASSERT both manager links remain ACTIVE, including ClickCease 2815082755.

rollback_plan.method: Re-create the removed criteria on shared set 11252984411 with SharedCriterionService using the exact text and BROAD match type recorded in proposed_removals.
rollback_plan.data_loss: None. Shared criteria carry no performance history of their own.
rollback_plan.note: Criterion IDs are assigned by Google on create and will differ after rollback.

partial_write_protocol: Send all removals in ONE MutateSharedCriteria request with partial_failure=false. If it fails, STOP, re-query the list, inventory exactly which criteria were removed, and produce a recovery plan before any retry.
